trace.method: CDP devtools.timeline + screenshot + compositor presentation reports
trace.mainThreadWork: union of Save-owned synchronous scope timestamps plus the CrRendererMain RunTask containing the Saving and Saved DOM mutations; ambient renderer tasks during WebCrypto/network waits are excluded; overlap is unioned once
trace.mainThreadRunTaskWindowWork: separate diagnostic union of all CrRendererMain RunTask intervals from Save click through durable receipt; includes unrelated Stage/rendering work during waits and is not a Save-work metric
trace.requestBoundary: save:request is marked immediately before fetch after JSON request-body construction
trace.backgroundRendererWork: same renderer process non-main-thread RunTask interval union
trace.feedback: first screenshot after the Saving label survives one render opportunity, joined by exact source/frame identity to one STATE_PRESENTED_ALL reporter before durable receipt
trace.visualEvidence: representative CDP trace screenshots for S/warm and M cache cells; all six cells retain exact frame-identity presentation data for every measured sample
